title: SPECTRA-X Standardized Candidate Contract Schema
description: Formal contract definition for candidate anomaly records across all SPECTRA-X modules (ASTROVISION, SPECTRA, CHRONOS-X, MOTION-X, FUSION-X).

candidate_id.description: Unique identifier for the astronomical source or detection (e.g. SPX-J162.1760-69.7529).

ra.description: Right Ascension in decimal degrees (J2000 / ICRS).

observation_id.description: SPHEREx observation ID or dither group identifier (e.g. 2026W30_1B_0003_1).

observation_time.description: UTC timestamp or MJD string of observation epoch.

module_name.description: Name of the discovery module generating this candidate evaluation.

anomaly_score.description: Quantitative anomaly magnitude generated by the module. Meaning governed by score_type.

score_type.description: Defines the physical / mathematical interpretation of anomaly_score.

uncertainty.description: Propagated statistical or systematic uncertainty in the score or measurement, if available.

quality_flags.description: Bitwise quality flag word from SPHEREx Level-2 FLAGS HDU.

evidence_summary.description: Human-readable scientific summary describing why the candidate triggered.

input_provenance.description: Source files, FITS extensions, or catalog lines used to derive the score.
